planets.name: TrES-4 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TrES-4 with a 3.55-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: TrES-4 b was found in 2007 by TrES as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TrES-4. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2007, disc_facility TrES, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.55392921, pl_radj 1.61, pl_bmassj 0.78

quotes.title: TrES-4b
quotes.introduction: It was discovered in 2006, and announced in 2007, by the Trans-Atlantic Exoplanet Survey, using the transit method.
